source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check HDD could be insert/remove

1. Insert HDD to BP.
2. Remove HDD form BP.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Make sure HDD could insert/remove normally.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator insertion/removal with `lsblk` and a 30-line `dmesg` tail.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Enumeration and kernel-tail evidence across cycles.
deepseek_columns.risk: Physical hot-plug requires an operator and a hot-swap-capable bay.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly retains operator hot-plug but lacks stable bay/serial mapping, target-state protection, full events and defined cycle count.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds hot-swap proof, unused target, per-cycle evidence, OOB recovery and physical notes.

original_test_intent: Confirm that every project-selected HDD and backplane bay permits normal mechanical insertion and removal and, when tested powered, cleanly enumerates and disappears without storage, controller or BMC faults.
original_method: For each approved drive-bay pair, a qualified operator performs the physical insert/remove sequence using the platform's powered-state and carrier procedure; the agent captures serial-bound OS/controller/udev/BMC evidence before, during and after each action.
manual_activity: Insertion and removal, including mechanical seating and latch behavior, are the actual acceptance operations. The agent can observe enumeration but cannot perform or attest the physical core, so this is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: List of HDD serial/model/carrier and each chassis/backplane/enclosure bay
Per-bay hot-swap capability or powered-off service procedure
Drive mount, boot, RAID membership and data disposition
Number/order of cycles and mechanical acceptance criteria
Operator/ESD instructions, OOB access and recovery for failed detection/removal
safety_requirements: Never remove a boot, mounted, in-use, protected, RAID member or unknown drive outside an explicit failure/recovery plan.
Do not assume a bay is hot-swap capable; use the documented power state.
Match the physical label, bay, enclosure/port and drive serial before every action.
Stop on latch/connector resistance, unexpected power/thermal/media/controller event or identity mismatch.
Do not auto-rescan, power-cycle, reseat or retry; preserve the first event sequence.
agent_execution_scope: Build and verify the full drive-to-bay identity matrix and baseline state.
Capture complete udev/kernel/controller/BMC event windows around each operator action, not only a short tail.
Confirm expected serial presence/disappearance and no unintended array/mount change.
Compile per-bay results and Tool Result without claiming mechanical success or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the population, power state and data-safety plan.
Physically insert and remove every in-scope HDD and record mechanical behavior.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful but incomplete: `lsblk` is supplemental, a 30-line dmesg tail can omit the event, and neither proves mechanical insertion/removal or all-bay coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain full timestamped udev/journal or kernel and controller/BMC windows keyed to HDD serial and bay; use `lsblk` only as one inventory view.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Insert/remove operation, all-HDD scope and 15/8-minute fields are preserved; cycle count remains a required project input because the source does not state one.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL MECHANICAL TEST WITH PER-BAY TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a checked population matrix and event markers for every action, with operator notes/photos for latch, carrier, insertion force and full seating plus serial-correlated enumeration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, carriers, HDD types, backplane and controller.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record backplane/controller/BMC firmware, OS driver and inventory tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform drive service/hot-swap instructions and approved population map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete traceability and data-safety checks without replacing the physical test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Population list and per-bay service procedure.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enumeration cannot prove connector alignment, latch quality or acceptable insertion/removal force.

project_override_considerations: A project may define which HDD/bay combinations represent `all`; completion claims must name that population and cannot imply untested bays or carrier types.
expected_evidence: Approved HDD serial/model/carrier-to-bay matrix, hot-swap policy and safe pre-state
Per-action operator timestamp and mechanical observation/photo
Matching pre/insert/remove OS, udev/kernel, controller and BMC/SEL evidence
Final drive/bay/array/mount health, unresolved anomalies, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently test normal physical insertion/removal. Scope and powered-state details are missing inputs rather than conflicts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The physical intent is clear. The project must define the population and safe service procedure, but that does not make the review blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its useful read-only enumeration and operator boundary but replaces truncated evidence and implicit cycles with explicit per-bay controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps all safety gates and changes classification to MANUAL ONLY because the mechanical operation is itself the acceptance target.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes `all HDD` a declared population and separates physical result, Tool Result and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a single `lsblk` snapshot from being treated as proof that every carrier and bay inserts/removes normally.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is fundamentally a mechanical serviceability test. System telemetry is valuable corroboration, but automation cannot assess seating, latch action or perform removal, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not rescan, reseat, repeat a cycle or power-cycle automatically after a missing device or fault. Preserve the first event and await the storage owner.
